name: JW Marriott Hotel Lima
insider_take: This sophisticated oceanfront sanctuary in Miraflores puts you at the epicenter of Lima's culinary renaissance, where world-class dining meets Pacific Ocean panoramas.
whats_special: Located in the prestigious Miraflores district, this luxury hotel sits directly on the dramatic cliffs overlooking the Pacific Ocean. The property features Lima's only rooftop pool with unobstructed ocean views and houses award-winning restaurants that showcase Peru's celebrated gastronomy scene. The hotel's position places you within walking distance of Parque Kennedy and the vibrant Barranco arts district.
pro_tip: Book a Pacific Ocean view room on higher floors for spectacular sunsets, and time your visit during Lima's summer months (December-April) when the coastal fog clears for the best ocean vistas.
dont_miss: The hotel's signature dining experiences featuring renowned Peruvian ingredients, paragliding adventures launching directly from the nearby Miraflores cliffs, and evening strolls along the oceanfront Malecón boardwalk. The nearby Huaca Pucllana, a 1,500-year-old adobe pyramid, offers fascinating glimpses into pre-Columbian Lima history just minutes away.
pros: Prime location in upscale Miraflores district with ocean views
Exceptional dining options including renowned restaurants
Luxurious spa and comprehensive fitness facilities
Premium JW Marriott service standards and amenities
cons: Urban hotel setting in busy district
